fact: The researchers developed a novel sensory manipulation to mimic unbiased noise in motion-selective visual cortex regions, which was verified by neuronal recordings in macaque areas MT/MST.
source_span: To test these predictions , we introduce a novel sensory manipulation that mimics the addition of unbiased noise to motion-selective regions of visual cortex, which we verified with neuronal recordings from macaque areas MT/MST . To test these predictions , we introduce a novel sensory manipulation that mimics the addition of unbiased noise to motion-selective regions of visual cortex , which we verified with neuronal recordings from macaque areas MT/MST .
